_comment: The Elf voice (NPCConversation II.1b, SpeciesVoice). speech: the rules run over any shared line they say. voice: openers and closers. thought: their own thoughts by situation. script: two-person scripts, speaker 0 is always the Elf.

openers: IF YOU WILL PERMIT AN ELDER,
AS ME MOTHER SAID IN DA OLD TONGUE,
BETWEEN DA LEAVES AN' DA STARS,
ME HAB WATCHED KINGDOMS FALL, AN'
WIT DA PATIENCE OF AN OAK,
AS DA OLD SONGS HAB IT,
ME HEAR IT BEFORE YOU DO:
ONE LEARNS, IN A FEW CENTURIES,
closers: OR SO DA CENTURIES TELL ME!
ME SHALL REMEMBER IT LONGER DEN YOU!
MARK IT, IN A HUNDRED YEARS!
FORGIVE ME EARS FOR HEARIN' IT!
AS IT WAZ IN ME YOUTH.
IT WILL PASS. MOST TINKZ DO!
WIT DA GRACE OF DA OLD FORESTS!
SOME TINKZ IZ WORTH DA WAIT!

generic: DA ROSEBUSHES ALONG DIS STREET HAB BIN PRUNED BY A BUTCHER. ME {WEEP|SIGH|DESPAIR} A LIL'!
THREE CENTURIES OF PRACTICE AN' ME BRAID STILL WILL NO SIT RIGHT ON {MONDAYS|RAINY DAYS|MARKET DAYS}!
DAT YOUNG MAN WILL BE OLD BY DA TIME ME FINISH DIS {BOOK|TAPESTRY|SONNET}. POOR TINK!
ME EARS CAUGHT A QUARREL THREE STREETS AWAY. MORTALS ARGUE SO PASSIONATELY 'BOUT SO LIL'!
ME MUST RESTRIN' ME {LUTE|HARP|BOW} TONIGHT. DA DAMP GETS INTO EVERYTINK HERE!
DAT BUILDIN' WAZ NEW WHEN ME LAST PASSED. NOW IT IZ CHARMIN'. GIVE IT A CENTURY, IT WILL BE BEAUTIFUL!
SOMEBODY IZ WHISTLIN' AN AIR ME WROTE IN {1740|1802|1655}. BADLY, BUT WIT FEELIN'!
ME SHOULD WATER DA {ORCHIDS|FERNS|LEMON TREE}. DEY SULK IF ME IZ LATE, AN' SO DO ME!
EVERY YEAR DA SHOP WINDOWS GET BRIGHTER AN' DA SHOPKEEPERS RUDER!
A HAWK OVERHEAD. TWO HUNDRED PACES UP, AN' IT HAB A SPARROW IN MIND. ME DO NO ENVY DA SPARROW!
ME SET A SAPPHIRE DIS MORNIN'. PERFECT. ME SHALL NO TOUCH ANOTHER STONE UNTIL ME CALM DOWN!
PEOPLE KEEP ASKIN' ME AGE. ME KEEP ANSWERIN' {'OLD ENOUGH'|'OLDER DEN YA TOWN'|'RUDE QUESTION'}!
DA GUILD SENT ME ANOTHER LETTER. SEALED WIT WAX. AT LEAST DEY REMEMBER HOW LETTERS SHOULD LOOK!
ME BOUGHT A TELEVISION. IT IZ LOUD AN' REAL LIL' AN' EVERYONE IN IT IZ IN A HURRY!
DERE IZ A {WREN|ROBIN|THRUSH} NESTIN' IN ME WINDOW BOX. ME HAB REARRANGED ME WEEK AROUND IT!
MORTAL FASHION CHANGES SO FAST. ME WORE DIS COAT IN 1890 AN' IT HAB COME BACK TWICE!
DA LEYLINES HUM A LIL' SOUR TODAY. SOMEBODY UPSTREAM IZ DAMPENIN' DEM, ME EXPECT!
ME COULD OUTWAIT DIS QUEUE. ME COULD OUTWAIT DIS WHOLE BUILDIN', FRANKLY!
DA BAKER'S DAUGHTER HAB HER GRANDFATHER'S NOSE. ME REMEMBER HIS GRANDFATHER'S NOSE TOO!
SUNLIGHT THROUGH LINDEN LEAVES. NOBODY ELSE HAB EVEN LOOKED UP. DEY LOSS!
ME {GLOVES|BOOTS|CLOAK} COST MORE DEN DAT CAR. DEY WILL ALSO OUTLAST IT!
A CHILD JUST ASKED IF ME EARS IZ REAL. ME ASKED IF HER NOSE WAZ. WE IZ EVEN!
DA CLOCKS HERE ALL DISAGREE BY A MINUTE. AS IF A MINUTE MATTERED TA ANYONE!
ME HAB BIN MEANIN' TA LEARN TA DRIVE PROPERLY. SINCE 1923. DERE IZ NO RUSH!
DA CHOIR AT {DA CHURCH|DA SCHOOL|DA STATION} SANG FLAT AGAIN. ME SAID NUTTIN'. HEROICALLY!
ANOTHER NEW BUILDIN' OF GLASS AN' GREY. MORTALS BUILD MIRRORS AN' DEN HATE WHAT DEY SEE!
ME SHOULD WRITE ME MEMOIRS. ME KEEP STARTIN', AN' DEN ANOTHER CENTURY HAPPENS!
ONE GREY HAIR. ONE. ME SHALL HAB IT FRAMED, OR BURNED!
DA FLORIST HAB FINALLY LEARNED TA WRAP PEONIES PROPERLY. IT ONLY TOOK HER THIRTY YEARS!
ME CAN HEAR DA RADIO IN DA FLAT BELOW. EVERY SONG LASTS THREE MINUTES. HOW DO DEY FALL IN LOVE SO FAST?
ME BOW HAB NO BIN DRAWN IN A YEAR. IT IZ BEGINNIN' TA LOOK AT ME REPROACHFULLY!
DA OLD ELM IN DA SQUARE IZ ILL. NOBODY NOTICES. ME NOTICE!
DEY PUT A VENDIN' MACHINE WHERE DA FOUNTAIN USED TA BE. PROGRESS, DEY CALL IT!
TODAY ME SHALL BE PATIENT WIT EVERYONE. IT IZ A LIL' ENCHANTMENT, AN' A HARD ONE!
A PIGEON HAB LANDED BESIDE ME AN' IZ JUDGIN' ME POSTURE. ME IZ JUDGIN' ITS PLUMAGE. TRUCE!
ME WORE SILVER TODAY. SILVER IZ FOR DAYS WHEN ONE EXPECTS TA BE ADMIRED!
MORTALS SAY 'IN ME DAY'. ME HAB HAB SO MANY DAYS ME NO LONGER KNOW WHICH ONE IZ ME!
SOMEONE HAB PAINTED DEY DOOR A PERFECT SHADE OF MOSS GREEN. ME MAY CALL ON DEM, SIMPLY TA SAY SO!
DA STARS OVER DIS TOWN IZ DIMMED BY STREETLAMPS. ME REMEMBER DEM BRIGHTER. ME REMEMBER EVERYTINK BRIGHTER!
ME COUSIN WRITES DAT VARLENIA IZ {LOVELY|DREADFUL|LOVELY AN' DREADFUL} DIS SEASON. AS ALWAYS!

sleep: A SHORT REST WIT ME EYES HALF OPEN, AN' ME SHALL BE ME AGAIN!
EVEN AN ELF FRAYS WITOUT SLEEP. ME IZ FRAYIN' AT DA {EDGES|EARS|TEMPER}!
ME NEED LINEN SHEETS AN' AN OPEN WINDOW. DA NIGHT HAB BIN TALKIN' WITOUT ME!
TOO LONG AWAKE. ME REFLECTION LOOKS ALMOST THREE HUNDRED!
SLEEP, A LIL'. DA STARS WILL KEEP WATCH. DEY HAB DONE IT LONGER DEN ME HAB!
BED. BEFORE ME SAY SOMETINK UNKIND 'BOUT SOMEONE'S TASTE IN CURTAINS!
hunger: ME COULD EAT. SOMETINK WIT HERBS IN IT,. NUTTIN' IN A WRAPPER!
A PEAR, A LIL' CHEESE, A GLASS OF WHITE WINE. IZ DAT SO MUCH TA ASK OF A CITY?
HUNGRY. IT IZ SO UNDIGNIFIED. ME STOMACH HAB NO SENSE OF OCCASION!
DA SMELL FROM DAT {BAKERY|KITCHEN|MARKET STALL} HAB QUITE UNDONE ME COMPOSURE!
ME FORGOT TA EAT AGAIN. ONE GETS LOST ADMIRIN' TINKZ!
ELVES CAN GO A LONG TIME WITOUT FOOD. A LONG TIME IZ NOW OVER!
work: BACK TA DA {WORKSHOP|EMBASSY|GREENHOUSE}. BEAUTY DOES NO MAKE ITSELF, SADLY!
A CLIENT WANTS DEY RING BY FRIDAY. FRIDAY! ME HAB SPENT LONGER CHOOSIN' A STONE!
ME EMPLOYER IZ FORTY AN' CALLS ME 'YOUNG LADY'. ME LET HIM. IT AMUSES ME!
ANOTHER DAY OF DIPLOMACY. SMILE, NOD, REMEMBER EVERYTINK DEY WILL FORGET!
ME HAB DONE DIS WORK FOR NINETY YEARS. ME STILL FIND NEW WAYS TA DO IT BETTER!
WORK, DEN A LONG EVENIN'. MORTALS DO IT DA OTHER WAY ROUND AN' WONDER WHY DEY IZ TIRED!
leisure: ME NEED AN AFTERNOON WIT A BOOK, A WILLOW AN' ABSOLUTELY NOBODY!
A CONCERT TONIGHT. IF DA CELLIST IZ POOR ME SHALL LEAVE QUIETLY AN' LOUDLY!
ME HARP HAB BIN QUIET TOO LONG. SO HAB ME!
ME SHOULD GO TA DA {GALLERY|OPERA|BOTANICAL GARDEN}. ME SOUL IZ BEGINNIN' TA LOOK SHABBY!
A LONG WALK AMONG OLD TREES. DEY IZ DA ONLY ONES WHO NEVER INTERRUPT!
ARCHERY AT DAWN, POETRY AT DUSK. ANYTINK IN BETWEEN IZ NEGOTIABLE!
crime: DAT {NECKLACE|BROOCH|RING} IZ WASTED ON ITS OWNER. NO. ELEGANCE DOES NO STEAL!
ME COULD TAKE IT AN' BE GONE BEFORE DEY BLINKED. ME HAB BIN FASTER DEN MORTALS FOR CENTURIES!
A THEFT WOULD BE SO VULGAR. A CLEVER THEFT, THOUGH... NO!
NOBODY WATCHES AN ELF'S HANDS. DEY IZ ALWAYS LOOKIN' AT DA EARS!
ME HAB OUTLIVED THREE POLICE FORCES IN DIS CITY. DA FOURTH LOOKS KEENER!
PATIENCE. IF ME WANT IT BADLY ENOUGH, ITS OWNER WILL DIE OF OLD AGE EVENTUALLY!
hygiene: ME NEED A BATH WIT ROSEMARY IN IT. AN' A COMB. AN' AN HOUR OF NOBODY KNOCKIN'!
ME HAIR IZ A DISGRACE. AN ELF WIT TANGLED HAIR IZ A SAD OMEN!
DERE IZ CITY DUST ON ME SLEEVES. ME FEEL LIKE AN OLD STATUE!
ME SMELL OF {BUS|CROWD|CHIP SHOP}. DIS NO CAN CONTINUE!
CLEAN WATER, LAVENDER SOAP, A LONG MIRROR. DA BASIC DIGNITIES!
ME EARS NEED CLEANIN'. YOU HAB NO IDEA WHAT DEY COLLECT. NEITHER DO ME, AN' ME PREFER IT SO!
money: ONLY {FORTY|SIXTY|NINETY} EUROS UNTIL DA END OF DA MONTH. ME JEWELS LOOK AT ME HOPEFULLY!
ME FAMILY IZ IN VARLENIA, DROWNIN' IN MONEY. ME IZ HERE, WADIN' IN RENT!
ME COULD SELL A RING. EACH ONE REMEMBERS SOMEONE, THOUGH!
MONEY COMES AN' GOES. ME HAB WATCHED FORTUNES RISE AN' FALL LIKE TIDES. ME IZ LOW TIDE!
POVERTY IZ SO INELEGANT. ME MUST BE POOR BEAUTIFULLY, DEN!
A COMMISSION OR TWO WOULD HELP. SOMEBODY MUST WANT A SONG 'BOUT DEY DOG!
safety: SOMETINK MOVES IN DAT ALLEY. ME EARS SAY TWO OF DEM, AN' NO FRIENDLY!
ME WOULD FEEL SAFER WIT ME BOW. ME WOULD FEEL SAFEST WIT ME BOW AN' A HIGH WINDOW!
DIS STREET FEELS WRONG. ME HAB SURVIVED FOUR CENTURIES BY TRUSTIN' DAT FEELIN'!
A LONG LIFE IZ A CAREFUL LIFE. ME SHALL TAKE DA LIT ROAD!
DA AIR TASTES OF A BUBBLE NEARBY. TIME IZ SOUR HERE. BEST WALK AWAY SLOWLY!
FOOTSTEPS BEHIND ME, FIFTY PACES. DEY TINK ME NO CAN HEAR DEM. MORTALS!
comfort: A VELVET CHAIR, A FIRE, A GOOD VINTAGE. ME HAB EARNED DEM SEVERAL TIMES OVER!
ME ROOMS IZ TOO LIL' FOR ME FURNITURE, AN' ME FURNITURE IZ TOO OLD FOR DIS CENTURY!
ME MISS DA GARDEN TERRACE AT ME MOTHER'S HOUSE. DA HOUSE, MUCH LESS!
SILK CUSHIONS. IZ IT VAIN TA WANT SILK CUSHIONS? IT IZ. ME WANT DEM ANYWAY!
A QUIET ROOM DAT FACES EAST. DAT IZ ALL AN ELF NEEDS. AN' A HARP. AN' A VIEW!
DIS BENCH IZ REAL HARD AN' REAL MODERN. TWO QUALITIES ME DISTRUST!
social: ME HAB NO HAB A PROPER CONVERSATION IN WEEKS. EVERYONE HERE SPEAKS IN HEADLINES!
ME MISS ME MATES. MOST OF DEM IZ STATUES NOW, OR PORTRAITS, OR BOTH!
A DINNER PARTY. CANDLES, LONG TALK, SOMEONE WRONG 'BOUT BYRON. ME NEED IT!
MORTALS MAKE MATES SO QUICKLY. TEACH ME. ME TAKE 'BOUT THIRTY YEARS!
ME SHOULD CALL ON DA {FLORIST|OLD PROFESSOR|LADY UPSTAIRS}. SHE ALWAYS HAB GOSSIP AN' GOOD TEA!
LONELINESS LASTS LONGER IN AN ELF. ME WOULD RATHER NO LET IT SETTLE!

rain: RAIN ON DA LINDEN LEAVES. DA CITY FINALLY SOUNDS LIKE MUSIC!
ME HAIR AN' DA RAIN HAB AN OLD QUARREL. DA RAIN IZ WINNIN' TODAY!
RAIN IZ JUST DA SKY REMEMBERIN' SOMETINK. ME KNOW DA FEELIN'!
MORTALS RUN FROM DA RAIN. ME WALK. ME CLOAK WAZ MADE FOR DIS, IN {1801|1777|1840}!
DA GARDENS WILL BE GRATEFUL. DA GARDENERS, LESS SO!
SOFT RAIN, DA KIND DAT MAKES MOSS PROUD!
storm: THUNDER. SOMEWHERE A GOD IZ IN A MOOD. NO ME CONCERN!
A PROPER STORM. ME HAB NO SEEN ONE LIKE IT SINCE DA WINTER OF {1709|1816|1888}!
LIGHTNING IZ DA ONLY LIGHT DAT HURRIES AN' STILL LOOKS BEAUTIFUL!
ME EARS ACHE WIT DA PRESSURE. ELVES FEEL A STORM A DAY BEFORE IT COMES!
DA OLD OAK WILL HOLD. DA NEW FENCE WILL NO. LESSON IN DAT!
ME SHALL WATCH IT FROM DA WINDOW WIT A GLASS OF SOMETINK RED. STORMS DESERVE AN AUDIENCE!
snow: SNOW. EVERY FLAKE DIFFERENT, AN' DEY MELT BEFORE ANYONE LOOKS. HOW MORTAL OF DEM!
DA CITY IZ SILENT UNDER SNOW. AT LAST, A CITY WIT MANNERS!
ME LEFT NO FOOTPRINTS. OLD HABIT. DA CHILDREN WAZ REAL CROSS!
SNOW ON PINE BRANCHES. ME COULD LOOK AT IT FOR A DECADE!
MORTALS CURSE DA SNOW AN' DEN BUILD LIL' PEOPLE OUT OF IT. ENDEARIN'!
DA COLD MAKES ME EARS GO PINK. IT IZ DA ONE FLAW ME ALLOW ME!
clear: CLEAR SKIES. ME CAN SEE DA HILLS FORTY MILES OFF, AN' A CROW ON EACH OF DEM!
A BLUE DAY. DA KIND OF DAY MORTALS WASTE INDOORS!
SUNLIGHT ON OLD STONE. ME FAVOURITE COLOUR HAB NO NAME IN YA LANGUAGE!
NO A CLOUD. DA SKY IZ SHOWIN' OFF, AN' ME APPROVE!
FINE WEATHER FOR ARCHERY. OR FOR SITTIN' IN A GARDEN PRETENDIN' TA READ!
SUCH CLEAR AIR. DA {CATHEDRAL|RIVER|OLD CASTLE} LOOKS ALMOST AS FINE AS IT DID WHEN IT WAZ NEW!

morning: DAWN. DA ONLY HOUR WHEN DA WHOLE WORLD IZ AS QUIET AS AN ELF!
MORNIN' DEW ON DA ROSES. ME COUNTED DA DROPS ONCE. IT TOOK A SUMMER!
UP BEFORE DA LARKS, AS IZ PROPER. DA MORTALS STUMBLE OUT AT EIGHT, GRUMBLIN'!
A FRESH MORNIN'. ANOTHER DAY TA BE PATIENT WIT EVERYONE. LET US SEE HOW LONG IT LASTS!
ME BRUSHED ME HAIR BY DA WINDOW AN' WATCHED DA {BAKER|MILKMAN|POSTMAN} MAKE HIS ROUNDS!
DA MORNIN' LIGHT IZ THIN AN' SILVER. ME FAVOURITE METAL, ME FAVOURITE HOUR!
afternoon: AFTERNOON. DA HOUR FOR TEA, A BOOK AN' MILD DISDAIN!
DA LIGHT GOES AMBER 'BOUT NOW. EVERYTINK LOOKS A CENTURY OLDER. IT SUITS DA TOWN!
MORTALS GROW SLEEPY AFTER LUNCH. ME GROW PHILOSOPHICAL. IT LOOKS DA SAME FROM OUTSIDE!
A LONG AFTERNOON. TA ME, DEY IZ ALL LONG. DAT IZ RATHER DA POINT OF BEING ME!
SHADOWS STRETCHIN'. DA TREES IZ POINTIN' AT SOMETINK. DEY ALWAYS KNOW!
HALFWAY THROUGH DA DAY AN' NOBODY HAB SAID ANYTINK BEAUTIFUL. DERE IZ STILL TIME!
evening: EVENIN'. CANDLES, WINE, AN' SOMEONE TA DISAGREE WIT 'BOUT MUSIC!
DA SUNSET WAZ ADEQUATE TONIGHT. SEVEN OUT OF TEN. ME IZ A STRICT JUDGE!
DA FIRST STAR. ME SAID HELLO TA IT. IT HAB BIN DERE LONGER DEN ME, AN' DAT IZ RARE!
EVENINGS WAZ MADE FOR SINGIN'. MORTALS USE DEM FOR TELEVISION. EACH TA DEY OWN!
DUSK TURNS DA RIVER TA PEWTER. ME SHALL WALK ALONG IT SLOWLY, AS IZ PROPER!
DA STREETLAMPS COME ON ONE BY ONE, LIKE A SHY CHOIR!
night: NIGHT. ME SEE WELL ENOUGH IN IT. MORTALS CARRY LIL' LIGHTS AN' STILL TRIP OVER TINKZ!
DA OWLS IZ OUT. DEY TALK SUCH NONSENSE, BUT IN SUCH LOVELY VOICES!
MIDNIGHT, AN' DA STARS HAB SHIFTED AGAIN. SINCE DA SQUISHING DEY DO NO STAY WHERE ME LEFT DEM!
A LIL' SLEEP IZ ENOUGH FOR ME. NIGHT, THOUGH, ME WANT PLENTY OF!
MOONLIGHT ON DA ROOFTOPS. SILVER EVERYWHERE AN' NOBODY AWAKE TA STEAL IT!
DA CITY SLEEPS. ME CAN HEAR EVERY CLOCK IN IT, TICKIN' OUT MORTAL LIVES!

SPRING: SPRING AGAIN. ME FOUR HUNDREDTH, GIVE OR TAKE. IT STILL MAKES ME GIDDY!
BLOSSOM ON DA {CHERRY|ALMOND|APPLE} TREES. GONE IN A WEEK. MORTALS UNDERSTAND DAT BETTER DEN ME DO!
DA SAP IZ RISIN'. ME CAN ALMOST HEAR IT IF ME PUT ME EAR TA DA BARK!
SPRING CLEANIN'. ME SHALL AIR OUT DA TAPESTRIES AN' ARGUE WIT DA MOTHS!
NEW LEAVES, YOUNG AN' FOOLISH. ME ADORE DEM!
SUMMER: SUMMER. LONG EVENINGS, FINALLY DA RIGHT LENGTH FOR A CONVERSATION!
TOO HOT FOR VELVET. ME SHALL SUFFER IN LINEN, ELEGANTLY!
DA ROSES IZ AT DEY BEST. SO IZ ME. WE IZ RIVALS FOR DA SEASON!
A MIDSUMMER FESTIVAL TONIGHT. ME KNOW SONGS FOR IT DAT NOBODY ELSE REMEMBERS!
LIME TREES IN FLOWER. DA WHOLE STREET SMELLS LIKE AN OLD LOVE LETTER!
AUTUMN: AUTUMN. DA MOST ELVEN OF SEASONS: BEAUTIFUL, SLOW, A LIL' PROUD OF ITS OWN DECLINE!
DA BEECHES HAB TURNED COPPER. ME SHALL MAKE EARRINGS OF DA COLOUR, IF NO DA LEAVES!
HARVEST TIME. MORTALS SING MORE IN AUTUMN. ME HAB ALWAYS NOTICED!
FALLEN LEAVES ON DA PATH. ME WALK AROUND DEM. DEY HAB HAB A HARD ENOUGH DAY!
A GOOD VINTAGE DIS YEAR, ME CAN SMELL IT FROM DA VINES. ME SHALL OPEN IT IN FIFTY YEARS!
WINTER: WINTER. DA TREES SLEEP AN' ME KEEP DEM COMPANY WIT LONG THOUGHTS!
BARE BRANCHES AGAINST A WHITE SKY. MORTAL PAINTERS NEVER GET DA GREY RIGHT!
FUR COLLAR, SILVER BROOCH, AN' A FIRE. WINTER IZ SIMPLY AN EXCUSE TA DRESS WELL!
ANOTHER WINTER. DEY COME ROUND SO QUICKLY, LIKE A SONG ON A JUKEBOX!
FROST ON DA WINDOW IN FERN SHAPES. NATURE STILL REMEMBERS HOW TA BE ORNAMENTAL!

poor: DARNED CUFFS AN' A BORROWED BOW. ME HAB BIN RICH BEFORE. ME SHALL BE AGAIN, EVENTUALLY!
ME FAMILY IN VARLENIA WOULD NO RECOGNISE ME IN DIS COAT. DAT MAY BE ITS BEST FEATURE!
POOR, BUT ME POSTURE IZ STILL WORTH A FORTUNE!
ME SOLD ME LAST GOOD RING FOR RENT. IT WAZ A GIFT FROM A DUCHESS. SHE WOULD HAB UNDERSTOOD!
BREAD AN' WATER, BUT SERVED ON ME GRANDMOTHER'S SILVER PLATE. ONE KEEPS STANDARDS!
A LONG LIFE HAB ITS LEAN DECADES. DIS IZ ONE. ME SHALL SING THROUGH IT!
comfortable: ENOUGH TA LIVE GRACEFULLY, TOO LIL' TA BE VULGAR. DA IDEAL BALANCE!
A GOOD FLAT, A GOOD HARP, A GOOD WINE ON SUNDAYS. ME NEED NUTTIN' FROM VARLENIA!
ME SAVINGS HAB GROWN SINCE {1820|1868|1904}. COMPOUND INTEREST IZ MORTAL PATIENCE, BORROWED!
ME COULD AFFORD DA OPERA EVERY WEEK. ME GO EVERY MONTH, TA KEEP IT SPECIAL!
COMFORTABLE. A WORD MORTALS USE APOLOGETICALLY. ME USE IT WIT RELISH!
A LIL' GARDEN OF ME OWN AN' NOBODY TA TELL ME HOW TA PRUNE IT. WEALTH ENOUGH!
rich: ME HAB MORE JEWELS DEN DAYS IN A YEAR. ME WEAR DEM IN ROTATION, OF COURSE!
ME VARLENIA ESTATE HAB A WALL, A MOAT AN' A LEYLINE DAMPER. OVERKILL, SAYS ME SISTER. SHE HAB TWO!
MONEY IZ EASY WHEN ONE HAB HAB FOUR CENTURIES OF INTEREST!
ME BOUGHT DA WHOLE ORCHARD SO NOBODY COULD CUT IT DOWN. DEN ME BOUGHT DA NEXT ONE!
DA BAGS DAT FALL FROM DA SKY OVER ME ESTATE IZ SOMEONE ELSE'S PROBLEM. ME PAY PEOPLE TA MAKE SURE!
RICHES IZ DULL, HONESTLY. BUT DEY DO KEEP DA RAIN OFF A REAL GOOD HAT!

familiar: DOZE TRAVELLERS AGAIN. STILL IN A HURRY. STILL ALIVE. BOTH IZ ACHIEVEMENTS!
ME REMEMBER DAT PARTY. ONE OF DEM HAB HAB A HAIRCUT. NO A GOOD ONE!
DA ROAD-FOLK IZ BACK. ME SHALL BOW, SLIGHTLY. SLIGHTLY IZ A GREAT HONOUR!
AH, DEM. DEY HAB AGED A LIL' SINCE LAST TIME. MORTALS DO DAT BETWEEN VISITS!
DOZE TRAVELLERS WALK LIKE PEOPLE WHO HAB SEEN STRANGE TINKZ. ME APPROVE OF STRANGE TINKZ!
DEY REMEMBERED ME NAME. MOST MORTALS REMEMBER ONLY DA EARS!
BACK AGAIN? GOOD. ME HAB KEPT A {SONG|STORY|BOTTLE} FOR DEM!
DAT PARTY SMELLS OF PETROL AN' ADVENTURE. MOSTLY PETROL!
ME HOPE DEY STAY A WHILE. DEY KIND IZ SO BRIEF, AN' SO INTERESTIN'!
DA CAMPER PEOPLE AGAIN. ME HEARD DEY ENGINE FROM DA EDGE OF TOWN!
hordeGround: HORDE GROUND. DA GOBLINS SING ALL NIGHT. OFF-KEY, BUT WIT CONVICTION!
DEY PAINTED DA OLD FOUNTAIN BLACK. CORPSE PAINT ON MARBLE. ME MAY NEVER RECOVER!
DA HORDE DOES NO KNOW WHAT TA MAKE OF AN ELF. NEITHER DO ME, SOME DAYS!
A GOBLIN ASKED IF ME EARS WAZ A HAT. ME SAID YES. HE WANTS ONE NOW!
UNDER DA HORDE DA GARDENS HAB GONE WILD. HONESTLY, AN IMPROVEMENT ON DA COUNCIL'S WORK!
ME KEEP ME HEAD DOWN AN' ME BOW UNSTRUNG. PATIENCE OUTLASTS INVASIONS. ME HAB SEEN SEVERAL!
DA HORDE'S BANNERS IZ HIDEOUS. ME HAB OFFERED TA REDESIGN DEM. DEY TOOK IT AS A THREAT!
JUNEHEM ON EVERY SPEAKER, EVERY HOUR. ME MISS DA HARPSICHORD!
A GOBLIN CHILD BROUGHT ME A {BEETLE|SHINY STONE|BOTTLE CAP}. A GIFT. ME IZ ODDLY MOVED!
DA HORDE CAME FROM DA NORTH, LIKE WINTER. WINTERS END. ME SHALL WAIT!
abroad: DA MAINLAND IZ LOUD AN' CROWDED AN' ALIVE. VARLENIA IZ QUIET AN' GATED AN' SOMETINK ELSE!
ME MOTHER WRITES EVERY MONTH ASKIN' WHEN ME SHALL COME HOME. ME WRITE BACK 'BOUT DA WEATHER!
HERE PEOPLE ASK 'BOUT ME EARS. IN VARLENIA DEY ASK 'BOUT ME CHARTER. ME PREFER DA EARS!
ME CHOSE A LIL' FLAT IN AN OLD CITY OVER AN ESTATE IN DA CITY OF GHOSTS. ME FAMILY THINKS ME IZ UNWELL!
DA MORTALS HERE HAB BIN KIND. ROUGH AT DA EDGES, BUT KIND ALL DA WAY THROUGH!
ME HAB A LIBRARY CARD, A BICYCLE AN' A NEIGHBOUR WHO BRINGS SOUP. ME IZ RICH IN DA WRONG WAYS!
VARLENIA HAB PERFECT WEATHER. HERE IT RAINS ON ME PERSONALLY. ME FIND ME LIKE DAT BETTER!
DA BOAT TA VARLENIA COSTS A FORTUNE AN' LEAVES ONCE A WEEK. ME HAB MISSED IT ON PURPOSE FOR A YEAR!
OLD EUROPE STILL HAB TREES OLDER DEN ME IZ. DAT IZ WHY ME STAY!
ME NEIGHBOURS CALL ME 'DA TALL ONE WIT DA EARS'. IT IZ DA WARMEST TITLE ME HAB HELD!

longevity: ME WATCHED DEM LIGHT DA FIRST GAS LAMPS ON DIS STREET. NOW DEY IZ ELECTRIC. NEXT, WHO KNOWS!
NINETY THOUSAND SUNSETS, AN' ME STILL STOP FOR A GOOD ONE!
PEOPLE ASK DA SECRET OF A LONG LIFE. PATIENCE, BEAUTY AN' NEVER DRIVIN' OVER EIGHTY!
ME OUTLIVED ME FIRST LOVE, ME SECOND, AN' ME FOURTH. DA THIRD IZ STILL WRITIN' TA ME. FROM LISBON!
A MORTAL MATE JUST TURNED EIGHTY. ME BOUGHT HER FLOWERS ME FIRST SAW BLOOM IN HER GRANDMOTHER'S GARDEN!
DA HARD PART OF A LONG LIFE IZ DA GOODBYES!
ME PASSPORT SAYS BORN IN {1612|1588|1640}. DA CLERK READ IT, LOOKED AT ME, AN' WENT FOR A COFFEE!
MORTALS MEASURE LIFE IN YEARS. WE MEASURE IT IN OAKS. ME IZ 'BOUT TWO OAKS OLD!
varlenia: VARLENIA APPEARED IN JANUARY AN' WAZ SOLD OUT BY MARCH. ME UNCLE WAZ FIRST OFF DA BOAT!
DA CITY OF GHOSTS IZ REAL BEAUTIFUL AN' REAL PALE. DA GHOSTS, ME IZ TOLD, IZ PURELY AESTHETIC!
BODY BAGS FALL FROM DA SKY IN VARLENIA. ME COUSIN CALLS IT 'OVERFLOW' AN' CHANGES DA SUBJECT!
A VARLENIAN CHARTER COSTS MORE DEN A MORTAL EARNS IN A LIFETIME. SEVERAL OF ME LIFETIMES, HONESTLY!
DA GARDENS IN VARLENIA IZ PERFECT. TOO PERFECT. NUTTIN' GROWS DERE DAT WAZ NO PAID FOR!
DEY DAMPEN DA LEYLINES OVER VARLENIA SO DA MAGIC STAYS CALM. SOMEWHERE ELSE PAYS FOR DAT CALM!
HALF DA ELVES ME KNOW MOVED TA VARLENIA. DA OTHER HALF SING SAD SONGS 'BOUT DA FIRST HALF!
IZ VARLENIA FROM ANOTHER DIMENSION, OR DA GODS' LOCKED ROOM? NOBODY DERE ASKS, WHILE RENTS RISE!
beauty: VANITY IZ NO CARIN' FOR BEAUTY WHEN IT FADES. ME CARE ENORMOUSLY!
A WELL-CUT STONE HOLDS LIGHT DA WAY A GOOD SONG HOLDS SILENCE!
EVERY CENTURY HAB ONE PERFECT BUILDIN'. DIS ONE IZ STILL UNDECIDED!
ME SET EMERALDS FOR AN EMPRESS ONCE. HER NECK WAZ SHORTER DEN DA NECKLACE. WE ADJUSTED DA EMPIRE!
